name: Metorial

modes.label: Native service
modes.note: Hardware and complete resource tariff unverified.

caveats: Free 500k tool calls/month, Scale $250/month includes 2.5M calls and 20 seats, then $20/seat; extra calls $1/1500, callbacks $1/750. Does not guarantee arbitrary-code CPU/RAM hours; fair-use applies even to unlimited sessions. EU/US hosted, open-source self-hosting and enterprise on-prem.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

fleet.tiers: Dev: one environment, hobby limits, no production access; Scale and Enterprise provide higher service allowances.
fleet.notes: Tool calls, integrations and Workforce seats are not VM counts. No published per-account fresh running-machine/vCPU/GPU quota found; enterprise customization not an automatic fleet entitlement.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Managed providers let you deploy custom MCP server code without managing infrastructure. Upload your code and Metorial handles hosting, scaling, and deployment.
snapshot_auto.note: Not a sandbox/VM product: the only user code Metorial runs is custom MCP servers on a managed Node.js runtime (serverless-style, open-source function-bay). No machine state to checkpoint.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: A custom provider version is a versioned snapshot of your custom integration.
snapshot_on_demand.note: 'Snapshot' here means an immutable code version (with instant rollback), not a machine/filesystem snapshot.

harness_api.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
harness_api.note: Metorial is an MCP integration gateway used BY agents (sessions, tool calls, Workforce/portals, Magic Skills); it does not run or drive an agent harness inside a sandbox.

secret_proxy.quote: Auth configs are stored per user. If 100 users connect their Slack accounts, you have 100 auth configs. This keeps credentials isolated and auditable.
secret_proxy.note: Metorial stores OAuth tokens/API keys (auth configs, config vaults) and uses them server-side when executing MCP tool calls, so the calling agent never sees them; but it is a tool gateway, not a proxy that injects credentials into arbitrary outbound HTTP from a sandbox. Custom provider code receives its config values. Provider auth exports can extract tokens.

volume_attach.quote: Beyond the pre-built integrations in the Metorial catalog, you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it. Metorial handles scaling and monitoring.
volume_attach.note: No storage/volume product documented for hosted providers.

volume_shared.note: No volumes of any kind documented.

isolation.quote: Managed providers let you deploy custom MCP server code without managing infrastructure. Upload your code and Metorial handles hosting, scaling, and deployment. Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
isolation.note: Metorial is an MCP integration gateway, not a VM/sandbox product; the only user code it runs is custom MCP server code on a shared managed Node.js runtime, i.e. container-style multi-tenant hosting. No dedicated VM/microVM isolation is documented.

image_oci.quote: Beyond the pre-built integrations in the Metorial catalog, you can upload your own MCP server code and let Metorial host it. Metorial handles scaling and monitoring.
image_oci.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — custom providers are deployed by uploading Node.js source code, not an OCI/Docker image.

docker_inside.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
docker_inside.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the managed runtime only executes Node.js MCP server code, no described container-in-container capability.

nested_virt.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
nested_virt.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Metorial is a serverless-style MCP tool-call gateway, not a VM/sandbox with /dev/kvm access.

desktop.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
desktop.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Metorial is an MCP integration/tool gateway, not a machine with a graphical desktop.

browser.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
browser.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no managed/real browser product documented; Metorial proxies tool calls to third-party app APIs (Slack, GitHub, Gmail, etc.), not a browser.

computer_use.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
computer_use.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no desktop exists to drive via screenshots/clicks.

anti_bot.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
anti_bot.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no browser/scraping product, so no stealth/fingerprinting feature.

captcha_solving.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Metorial is an API/MCP gateway, not a browsing/automation product that would encounter CAPTCHAs.

ssh.quote: Upload your code and Metorial handles hosting, scaling, and deployment.
ssh.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — deployment is via code upload through the dashboard/API, no SSH access to the managed runtime is documented.

snapshot.quote: A custom provider version is a versioned snapshot of your custom integration.
snapshot.note: 'Snapshot' here means an immutable code version with rollback, not a machine/filesystem/memory snapshot; there is no persistent machine whose disk/memory state would be snapshotted.

fork.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no machine-cloning concept; scaling is handled by the managed runtime, not by user-initiated forking.

fork_running.note: not offered: outside the product's scope, same as fork.

memory_snapshot_fork.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no machine/process state exists to preserve across a clone.

pause_resume.quote: Managed providers let you deploy custom MCP server code without managing infrastructure.
pause_resume.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — there is no user-addressable long-lived machine to pause/resume; it's request-driven tool execution.

persistent_disk.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
persistent_disk.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no filesystem/disk persistence product documented for the managed MCP server runtime.

live_resize.quote: Metorial handles hosting, scaling, and deployment.
live_resize.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — there is no user-controlled machine sizing to resize; scaling is fully managed/automatic.

agent_harnesses.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
agent_harnesses.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Metorial is consumed BY external agent harnesses (Claude, OpenAI, AI SDK, etc.) as a tool gateway; it does not ship preinstalled coding-agent harnesses itself.

own_agent_api.quote: Metorial connects AI agents and MCP clients to the apps your team already uses, with access controls and activity logs.
own_agent_api.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no first-party browser/computer-use/research task agent is documented; Metorial provides tool/MCP access, not its own agent.

lang_python.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
lang_python.note: Managed custom provider runtime is Node.js only; Python is not supported for hosted custom providers.

lang_node.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js. TypeScript/JavaScript (Node.js): Full npm package support, Automatic TypeScript compilation, Node.js 18+ runtime

public_ipv4.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — deployments are reached via Metorial's own API/session model, not a dedicated public IPv4 per machine.

inbound_https.quote: When making a request, you'll always use this base URL: https://api.metorial.com
inbound_https.note: Metorial exposes deployed MCP tool endpoints over HTTPS via its own API surface (not a raw exposed port on a user machine).

ingress_rules.quote: Publishable API Keys ... Safe to use in client-side code. Secret API Keys ... Provides full project access, Must be kept private.
ingress_rules.note: Access to provider deployments/tool calls is gated by API keys (publishable vs secret) and per-user auth configs, i.e. provider-side access control, though not IP allowlisting.

guest_firewall.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
guest_firewall.note: Not a full VM/microVM with root access; it's a managed multi-tenant Node.js runtime, so guest-level firewall control (nftables/iptables) is not applicable/derived-false.

gpu.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
gpu.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — the managed runtime is a Node.js MCP server host, not compute infrastructure offering GPU machines.

windows.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
windows.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Metorial provides a managed Linux-based Node.js runtime, no Windows machines.

macos.quote: Hosted custom providers currently run on Node.js.
macos.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — no macOS machine offering documented.

byoc.quote: EU/US hosted, open-source self-hosting and enterprise on-prem.
byoc.note: Card documents open-source self-hosting and enterprise on-prem deployment, which functions as a BYOC-style deployment into the customer's own infrastructure for Enterprise plans.
